priorityList: Use Roll the Bones if you have 0 or 1 buff.
Use Keep It Rolling if you have 2 or more active buffs.
Spend Combo Points at 6 or more (or 5 or more if Between the Eyes is on cooldown).
Cast Slice and Dice if it is not active.
Cast Between the Eyes as your top priority finisher.
Use Killing Spree as a high-priority finisher.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher, or as a builder if the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Dispatch as your filler finisher.
Use Vanish or Shadowmeld to trigger Hidden Opportunity when you lack Audacity or Opportunity procs.
Cast Ambush whenever Audacity is active.
Use Pistol Shot with an Opportunity proc if stacks are maxed or to avoid overcapping energy.
Use Blade Rush for energy generation if you are not near maximum energy.
Use Ambush (via Hidden Opportunity) or Sinister Strike as your primary combo point generator.
Use offensive trinkets and racials while the Between the Eyes buff is active.
